hybrid.root_cause: Fault injection feature flag (cartFailure) enabled, causing cart service to fail connecting to Valkey cart storage.

baseline.root_cause: Payment failure feature flag is enabled

hybrid.root_cause: Payment failure feature flag is enabled, causing payment requests to fail with invalid token errors.

baseline.root_cause: The paymentFailure feature flag is enabled, causing the payment service to reject charge requests.

hybrid.root_cause: Quote and shipping services experiencing high latency ratios compared to baseline, impacting overall frontend-web performance.

baseline.root_cause: The ad service has a high CPU fault-injection flag enabled, causing increased latency and load.

hybrid.root_cause: The valkey-cart container has exited, preventing the cart service from connecting to its storage backend.

baseline.root_cause: valkey-cart container/service is stopped, causing cart storage failures during checkout.

hybrid.root_cause: The product-catalog container has exited and is stopped, leading to DNS resolution failures and errors across recommendations and frontend services.

baseline.root_cause: The product-catalog service container is down or unreachable, causing name resolution errors (Unable to resolve host product-catalog) in frontend and recommendation services.

hybrid.root_cause: The recommendation service container has an overly restrictive memory limit causing OOM kills and frequent restarts, leading to missing product recommendations on the storefront.

baseline.root_cause: The recommendationCacheFailure feature flag is enabled, causing failures in recommendation generation.

hybrid.root_cause: Currency service CPU limit is set too low (0.02), causing sluggish performance during currency conversion.

baseline.root_cause: Fault-injection feature flag intlShippingSlowdown is enabled, causing slow downs in international shipping/currency conversion during checkout.
